propagator.name: Propagator
propagator.description: Every 15 seconds of game time, seed the four adjoining plots as grass, add 1 Life concentration to each, and stabilize them.

deployment.instructions: Plant 1 Life. Leave the first 5-second window empty, then wait 10 seconds.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: Every 15 seconds of game time, gain 1 Life point per 8 total Life concentration on the four adjoining plots, rounded down.

deployment.instructions: Plant 1 Life and add 1 more within 5 seconds. Leave the next 10-second window empty, then wait 10 seconds.

extractor.name: Extractor
extractor.description: After a tide, draw 1 Life concentration from each positive plot in the surrounding eight. Every 8 drawn produces a liquid energy canister. Unused concentration carries over.

deployment.instructions: Plant 1 Life, add 1 more within 5 seconds, then add a third within the next 10 seconds. Wait 10 seconds.
